title: Chart Type
description: Schema for chart-type records: display metadata for chart pickers (name, group, expected series, complexity) and the Open XML mapping a picker can describe. One record per chart type that Aspose.Slides officially supports (see mappings.renderers["aspose-slides"].chartType), plus the column-and-line combination 'combo'. A document's chart.type is an engine vocabulary validated directly; engines never look a chart-type record up. pptx.gallery publishes these records and @openpresentation/gallery ships them as catalogDisplay.chartTypes.

^x-.description: Publisher extension member, such as the `x-gallery` presentation metadata that pptx.gallery adds to the records it publishes. Engines and validators ignore top-level `x-*` members, and the pinned snapshot in @openpresentation/gallery never carries them.

$schema.description: Identifies this record as a chart type in the open presentation catalog.

id.description: The chart-type value (`chart.type`) this record describes. Lowercase kebab-case; it may start with a digit (e.g., '100pct-stacked-column') to mirror conventional chart naming.

name.description: Human-readable name of the chart type, as a chart picker shows it.

summary.description: One-sentence positioning: when to reach for this chart variant.
examples: Single-series vertical column chart for comparing values across categories.
Stacked column chart that shows how the parts of each category add up to its total.

description.description: Longer prose describing the chart and ideal use cases.
examples: Use a stacked column when you want to compare totals across categories and also show how each series contributes — e.g., revenue by quarter split by product line. Best with 2–4 series and ≤12 categories.

mappings.description: Canonical and optional renderer-specific mappings used by engines to render this chart type.

group.description: Top-level grouping in the chart picker.

groupSort.description: Display ordering hint within the chart group.

complexity.description: Shape of the underlying data: a flat series ('simple'), one with engine-side calculation ('calculated'), parent-child rows ('hierarchical'), or pre-normalized rows ('normalized'). The editor offers only 'simple' types as switch targets for a chart's existing data.

series.description: Number of data series this chart type expects: exactly that many, except that a stacked or percent-stacked type and a combination (composition 'mixed', such as combo) expect at least that many. The editor offers a type that expects more than one series only for data with a fitting number of value columns; a one-series type fits one value column, and column, bar, line, area and radar types fit any number.

tags.description: Free-form labels for filtering and search.

preview.description: Visual previews of the record, used by picker UIs and inline rendering. All sub-fields are optional; engines fall back gracefully when previews aren't available.

src.description: Main preview image (PNG/JPG). Used as the primary visual in picker UIs and previews of the record.

thumbnailSrc.description: Smaller thumbnail preview suited to dense grid views.

vectorSrc.description: SVG / vector preview for crisp scaling at any size.

openxml.description: Canonical mapping to Open XML chart structures.

renderers.description: Optional renderer-specific mappings. Keys are renderer ids; values are intentionally opaque to OPF. The bundled catalog records the matching Aspose.Slides ChartType enumeration member under the "aspose-slides" key, e.g. {"aspose-slides": {"chartType": "StackedColumn"}}; a mixed composition names the ChartType it starts from and the series type it switches series to, e.g. {"chartType": "ClusteredColumn", "lineSeriesType": "LineWithMarkers"}.

element.description: Primary Open XML chart element or extension chart element, such as 'barChart', 'lineChart', 'pieChart', 'treemapChart', or 'waterfallChart'.

barDir.description: Bar direction for Open XML barChart mappings.

grouping.description: Open XML chart grouping value when the chart family supports grouping.

marker.description: Whether the chart type expects visible data markers.

radarStyle.description: Open XML radarStyle value for radarChart mappings.

scatterStyle.description: Open XML scatterStyle value for scatterChart mappings.

composition.description: Whether the chart maps to one standard chart element, multiple combined chart elements, or an Open XML extension chart.

extension.description: Optional Open XML extension namespace or element hint for extension charts.

series.description: Open XML chart elements used by mixed/composite chart types.

notes.description: Short implementation note for mappings that need renderer interpretation.
